description: Client-ops playbook, localized tier (premium). Premium live tier: one playbook re-checked and localized at call time for a named jurisdiction, with a generated 12-month deadline calendar. On the current snapshot build the live re-check cannot complete, so the call serves the record with its facts as checked and their as-of — plus the calendar where the record's own stated rules determine it — and names the degradation. $5 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

jurisdiction.description: jurisdiction to localize for, e.g. US-TX (required)
